text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin got injured during training, so 
I rushed her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I was a bit clumsy. I might have to 
take the day off from my part-time job 
today...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I don't really want to take a break 
from training...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I can put up with a little pain, so 
could I maybe just do a light workout...?
choice_data_list: Okay, let's do what we can.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I guess you're right... It'd be 
awful if my injury got worse, after all...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I understand. To make sure I recover 
quickly, I'll get plenty of rest today...

Ines Fujin sounded disappointed as she 
returned to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Well then, let's do whatever 
training we can!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Just putting a little weight on it 
sends throbs of pain through it...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"To think I can't even handle this tiny 
bit of training..."
choice_data_list: Maybe it's better not to move recklessly.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's true... I think I'll just rest as 
quietly as possible today...

Ines Fujin voiced her frustration and 
headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew. If it's just this much exercise, I 
think I can manage.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If we do it like this until the injury 
heals, my body won't get out of shape. 
What a relief~

Mindful of her injury, Ines Fujin trained 
within reasonable limits.
